fact: On 25 September 2025 the minister launched a public administration interoperability platform, piloted with 12 bodies including the tax directorate, CNPS, CNAM, CGRAE and ONECI, with the NNI named as the key to reach a citizen's records.
title: Côte d'Ivoire : l'interopérabilité, un catalyseur de la transformation digitale de l'administration
